raw_prompt: Implement password reset session invalidation that blacklists active refresh tokens across all clusters.

password reset.rationale: Security workflow triggering credential mutation and session termination.

session invalidation.rationale: State transition terminating active authenticated sessions.

session.rationale: Core auth aggregate tracking active user authentication state.

blacklist.rationale: Action of registering revoked token identifiers in a denial list.

token blacklist.rationale: Distributed datastore / cache holding revoked token identifiers.

refresh tokens.rationale: Cryptographic credential entity used to issue new access tokens.

across all clusters.rationale: Architectural distribution constraint requiring multi-cluster synchronization.

implement.rationale: Imperative directive keyword from user instruction.
